title: Ordinary Chern realization of a normalized supported class
statement: Let N>0, A a finite commutative ring killed by N, T a scheme on which N is invertible, and i:D→T a closed immersion with invertible kernel ideal. Use the concrete constant module sheaf and finite Tate line [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class], the supported boundary and divisor Chern class [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary], and the canonical derived unit and exact-direct-image realization [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-system]. If κ∈Ext²_A(i_*A_D,A_T(1)) satisfies the supported boundary, then the ordinary scalar cohomology realization of u_i ; supportedExactDerivedMap(κ) equals c₁(O_T(D)).

lean.statement:
theorem ordinary_supported_kummer_chern (T : Scheme.{u}) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))) {D : Scheme.{u}} (i : D ⟶ T)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible)
    (κ : Ext ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i).obj (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D))
      (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T N A hA) 2)
    (hκ : SupportedKummerBoundary A N hA i hI hT κ) :
    ordinaryFiniteClass A T (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T N A hA) 2
      (supportedDerivedUnit A i ≫ supportedExactDerivedMap
        (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) i) (ordinaryFiniteConstant A D)
        (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine T N A hA) κ) =
      supportedKummerChern A N hA i hI hT
